model.name: Eager child-count badges (structure+counts eager, content lazy)
model.description: Every traceability-tree node's child-count BADGE shows the correct count from when its PARENT loads (eager metadata) - not 0-until-expand. The count comes from the parent's /children response metadata (childCount per child), not a per-node prefetch. Lazy level-by-level: expanding loads children WITH their child-counts; deeper content loads on further expand. Structure+COUNTS eager; child CONTENT payload-lazy. THE BUG: all sprint nodes showed badge=0 initially.
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-13: tree badges show 0 until expand - must show the REAL child-count eagerly from the parent response metadata; content stays lazy.

discoverySource.note: S30 traceability-tree bug. Bugs FIXED + deployed v0.7.11 BEFORE the req = #126 slip; chain completed scenario-first retroactively.

model.crossRefNote: S30 traceability-tree family (R30.1). R30.2 eager-count reuses R26.4 structure-eager-payload-lazy; R30.3 selection->drawer ties R25.4/R27.8.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every tree node child-count BADGE shows the correct count from when its PARENT loads (eager) - NOT 0-until-expand.
The count comes from the PARENT /children response metadata (childCount per child), not a per-node prefetch.
Lazy level-by-level: expanding a node loads its children WITH their own child-counts (next level badges correct); deeper content on further expand.
THE BUG: all sprint nodes showed badge=0 initially - must show the real task-count before expand.
Still PAYLOAD-LAZY: children CONTENT loads on expand; only COUNTS are eager (structure+count eager / payload lazy - R26 pattern).
